lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region, with primary centroids aligned in parallel horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with circular blobs, most prominent in the region immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges visible on the dorsal-lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edges and low-intensity shadows on the inferior edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct vertical branchial slits characterized by high-contrast dark curves of low pixel intensity located anterior to the pectoral fin base.
